name: KeyGen
summary: Client-side suite of 39 generators for passwords, API keys, encryption keys and framework secrets, run in the browser.
description: A browser utility suite of 39 generators that run fully client-side with Web Crypto APIs: passwords, passphrases, PIN and recovery codes, API keys, JWT secrets, UUIDs, TOTP codes, test cards, framework secrets for Django, Laravel, Flask and WordPress, encryption keys (AES, RSA, HMAC), hashes, salts, SSH and PGP keys. Nothing generated is transmitted or stored.
contains: passwords: passphrase, pronounceable, memorable, master password, bulk
developer: API keys, JWT secret, UUID, random string, TOTP/2FA, test cards
framework secrets: Django, Laravel, Flask, WordPress
encryption: AES, RSA and HMAC keys, hash and salt generators
advanced keys: SSH, PGP/GPG, WireGuard, VAPID, usernames
100% client-side with Web Crypto APIs; nothing transmitted or stored
